name: Evie Templeton
bio: Evie Jayne Templeton is a British actress who is represented by Mark Jermin Management. She discovered her passion for acting at a young age. Her first recognizable role was on Red in 2020, in which she portrayed the character of Tally.

Struggling with grief and a fractured sense of reality, Ellie forms an unlikely bond with her charismatic roommate, Brenna Darby. credits.title: Victorian Psycho
credits.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

credits.title: Return to Silent Hill
credits.overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

credits.title: The Bunker
credits.overview: On the brink of nuclear destruction, a mother must make an impossible decision to protect her children.

credits.title: Lord of Misrule
credits.overview: When the daughter of the town's new priest goes missing during the harvest festival, a desperate search begins, uncovering the town's dark history and resurfacing tales of a mysterious, malevolent spirit that demands sacrifice.

credits.title: Pinocchio
credits.overview: A wooden puppet embarks on a thrilling adventure to become a real boy.

credits.title: Red
credits.overview: When an ex-soldier awakes in a bath of ice to discover he’s missing a kidney, and worse - his daughter, he must fight his way through the ‘Organ Harvesting Den’ to find her before it’s too late.
